priors.subject: fix(dashboards): Delay binding events on release bubbles (#99236)
priors.shape: Same subsystem (releases/echarts) and same root cause -- an ECharts instance that is not fully initialized during a transitional state. Fixed at the source by refusing to bind the mouse handlers until the chart model exists (`if (echartsInstance?.getModel())`), plus an explanatory comment, rather than by hardening the handler body.

priors.subject: fix(perf): cannot read property of undefined area chart (#72773)
priors.shape: Sentry-reported TypeError (JAVASCRIPT-2TK4) in chart code fixed by adding optional chaining at the exact access site (`data.map` -> `data?.map`); no test, no upstream change.

priors.subject: fix(releases): null check on versionInfo (#100940)
priors.shape: Sentry-reported TypeError (JAVASCRIPT-33S0) in releases UI fixed by inserting one `?.` into the property chain at the crash site; one-line defensive fix, no test.

priors.subject: fix(settings): Defensively check existence of project in case of project deletion (#102969)
priors.shape: Sentry-reported TypeErrors fixed by adding an early bail-out guard (`if (!project?.id) return ...`) plus optional-chained indexing, explicitly framed as defending against a transient state (deletion + re-render).

priors.subject: fix(ui): defensive indexed access in getItemIndexAtPosition (#93900)
priors.shape: Sentry-reported TypeError (JAVASCRIPT-31AG) fixed by dropping the non-null assertion and adding an explicit skip/early-exit guard (`if (!coords) continue;`) inside the callback that crashed.

note: The construction here -- optional chaining plus early-return guards planted at the crash site to close a Sentry-reported TypeError, with no test -- is a well-worn pattern in this repo, though the nearest prior in this exact subsystem (0a8a9d358b9) fixed the same 'echarts not ready' race by guarding at event-binding time instead of inside the handler.
